execution_overview.overall_summary: Built and ran a Python-based Docker environment. Executed the provided Python translation to fit MixedLM and OLS on the full dataset and on the dataset excluding six outlying villages. After fixing a filter bug, results show a significant positive effect of domlow on totinc in the full dataset that becomes non-significant when the six villages are excluded.

deviations.description: Fixed the exclusion filter for six outlying villages by comparing numeric village codes instead of strings.
deviations.reason: The original Python script compared 'village' as strings (e.g., '70' vs '70.0'), so the exclusion set was not applied and both datasets were identical.

method_fidelity.fidelity_note: Followed the planned multilevel (MixedLM) and OLS path; only corrected a filtering logic bug to implement the prespecified exclusion set.

test_statistics.other: Excluding six villages (n=1211), MixedLM yielded coef=-4552.016, SE~4.93e10, p=1.000, indicating no significant effect; OLS robustness shows similar pattern (see Task2).

result_raw.result_text: MixedLM on the full dataset shows that households in low-caste dominated villages have significantly higher total income; with the six outlying villages excluded, the effect is not significant.

conclusion.conclusion_text: The full-sample result supports the focal claim (positive and significant effect of low-caste village domination on household income), but the effect is not robust to excluding six identified outlying villages.

deviations.description: Corrected the village exclusion filter to use numeric comparison.
deviations.reason: To ensure the planned exclusion of six outlying villages was applied.

method_fidelity.fidelity_note: Used the planned OLS model without additional controls; implemented the prespecified village exclusions.

result_raw.result_text: OLS on the full dataset shows a significant positive association between low-caste village domination and household income; after excluding the six villages, the effect is no longer statistically significant at the 5% level (p≈0.053).

conclusion.conclusion_text: The full-sample OLS result supports the focal claim, but the effect becomes non-significant when excluding the six outlying villages, indicating limited robustness.
